title: Q($\gamma_H$): Entropy-Guided Horizon Mixing in Multi-Discount Q-Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21764v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A fixed discount factor in Q-learning imposes a single planning horizon throughout training, despite the differing demands of early exploration and long-term credit assignment. We propose Q($\gamma_H$), a multi-horizon Q-learning framework that maintains multiple discount-specific heads and adaptively combines them at control time using an entropy-derived confidence signal. The resulting state-dependent mixing weights shift control from shorter- to longer-horizon heads as policy confidence increases, enabling adaptive horizon mixing without modifying individual Bellman updates. Across classical control and deep reinforcement-learning benchmarks, Q($\gamma_H$) shows its strongest improvements on delayed-credit tasks relative to strong fixed-discount baselines. By decoupling horizon adaptation from the underlying learning updates, Q($\gamma_H$) provides a lightweight framework for adaptive planning-horizon control in reinforcement learning

translated_title: Q($\gamma_H$)：多折扣Q学习中的熵引导视界混合
translated_abstract: Q学习中的固定折扣因子在整个训练过程中强加了单一的计划视界，尽管早期探索与长期信用分配的需求各不相同。我们提出了Q($\gamma_H$)，这是一个多视界Q学习框架，它维护多个特定折扣的输出头，并在控制时使用由熵导出的置信度信号自适应地组合它们。由此产生的状态相关混合权重会随着策略置信度的增加而将控制从较短视界的输出头转向较长视界的输出头，从而在不修改单个Bellman更新的情况下实现自适应的视界混合。在经典控制和深度强化学习基准测试中，Q($\gamma_H$)相对于强大的固定折扣基线，在延迟信用任务上表现出最显著的改进。通过将视界自适应与底层学习更新解耦，Q($\gamma_H$)为强化学习中的自适应计划视界控制提供了一个轻量级框架。
tldr: 提出多视界Q学习框架Q($\gamma_H$)，通过维护多个折扣专用输出头并利用熵引导的置信度信号在控制时自适应混合，在不修改Bellman更新的情况下实现了轻量级的自适应规划视界控制，尤其在延迟信用任务上改进显著。
en_tdlr: Q($\gamma_H$) adaptively mixes multiple discount-specific heads at control time using entropy-derived confidence signals, providing a lightweight framework for adaptive planning-horizon control in reinforcement learning without modifying individual Bellman updates.
